Caline Caline CP-500 series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Caline CP-503 Queen Bee Overdrive Published on December 4, 2023 Caline CP-500 series overdrive pedal Information Caline CP-500 series A sweet and sticky tube amp-style overdrive that really reacts to your pick attack. Play softly and add a glistening warm grit to your tone, dig in and unleash a dynamic organic sounding overdrive that's perfect for blues and rock. Loves to be 'always on' or equally effective stacked with other drives to create a range of textures for your gain stages. Add rich harmonic overtones to your riffs and give your sound a sting in the tail! Knobs: VOLUME Knob: Controls the overall signal volume DRIVE Knob: Controls the amount of gain added to your signal â€" from tube-like sag to gritty overdrive FOCUS Knob: Adjusts the overall EQ brightness and the level of dynamic pick attack, allowing you to dial in the sweet spot on single coils, humbuckers or P90's.
